subject: RE: Great House Farm, Llandough, Cardiff
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear sir,

In answer to your email of 19/10/26:

1. All reasonable efforts to search Heneb’s planning and project archives and administrative files have been undertaken.  No information pertaining to your requests has been recovered.
2. The HER does not record this information.
3. Suggett, R.F.S. 1988 can be viewed here https://walesher1974.org/her/app/php/herumd.php?level=2&group=GGAT&docid=301530087&linktable=her_source1_link
4. Please find attached a redacted example of the change log. As you will note it does not contain information likely to be helpful to your research, as such we are unable to take on the onerous task of sharing further entries with you
5. 1st April 2024
6. These documents do not exist.
7. Heneb has no intention of deleting any files, nor changing any records.

Kind regards

The Heneb HER Team
